Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
AIR OPERATED HIGH PRESSURE GREASE PUMPS 



1. Scope — Covers the requirements for air operated high pressure grease pumps intended for use 
with grease having penetration of 265 and above at 25°C for general purpose applications 

2. Material — The materials used for high pressure grease pumps shall be such as to withstand 
normal wear and handling when used with grease up to a temperature of 60°C 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as shown in Fig 1 

4 Designation — Air operated high pressure grease pump suitable for grease drum of 50 kg capacity 
shall be designated as 



Air Operated High Pressure Grease Pump 50 IS 9772 



5. Design Features 



5.1 Grease pumps shall be robust in construction and shall be able to work effectively within the 
range of air pressure of 4 to 1 MPa ( 1 MPa » 10 2 kgf/cm 9 ) 

5 2 Alt packings shall be made of oil resisting materials 

5 3 AH moving parts shall be lubricated 

6 Workmanship and Finish 

6 1 The grease pumps shall be finished smooth and shall be free from burrs cracks and other 
manufacturing defects 

6 2 Exposed surfaces of grease pumps that come in contact with grease shall be plated and the rest 
painted with oil resistant paints Fasteners shall be zinc/cadmium plated 

7 Performance Test — The grease pump shall be fitted with 6 m long and 6 mm dia delivery hose 
The grease pump when fitted on a drum of suitable capacity and fed with compressed air shall be 
able to deliver grease at back pressures and discharge rates given below corresponding to the air 
pressure of 1 MPa 



Back Pressure 


Discharge 


(MPa) 


(grams) 





650 


5

8. Marking — The grease pumps shall be marked with working air pressure range, approximate ratio 
of the air pressure to the discharge pressure and manufacturer's name or trade-mark 

8 1 iSI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution 

9. Packing ■— The grease pumps shall be packed in accordance with the best prevalent trade 
practices or as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers the requirements of air operated high pressure grease pumps and is 
based on the manufacturing practices followed in the country.
